content.test_md_blob:
# Disable hover indicators from Customize and verify the active marker stays gone

> Prove disabling Hover Indicators prevents the performance chart from showing its active hover marker when the chart is hovered.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser and wait for the ORBITAL dashboard to finish rendering with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Performance chart, hover a data point and confirm the chart shows its active hover marker while Hover Indicators is still enabled.

## Step 3

Open the Customize control and keep the right-side drawer visible while working with the chart options.

## Step 4

In the Customize drawer's Chart options section, clear the Hover Indicators option.

## Step 5

Hover the Portfolio Performance chart again over a data point that previously showed the active marker.

## Step 6

Assert that the performance chart does not show an active hover marker after Hover Indicators has been disabled.

## Step 7 — assert @verifies ac-128, ac-140

Confirm 'an active hover marker on the performance chart' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: Disabling Hover Indicators prevents the performance chart from showing an active hover marker.
